rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure is directly covered under property_damage.
claim_summary: Jordan Lee (POL-1006) reported wind damage to back porch roof overhang with approximately 4 shingles blown off last weekend. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no water intrusion or secondary damage. Deductible is $2,500.

case_facts.description: wind blew approximately 4 shingles off the roof overhang
